thread:
Jordan (sales-eng): Heads-up — APAC POC hitting errors when they pin `redwood-2.1`. Demo is scheduled for tomorrow morning and they're blocked by model availability + occasional 429s.
Priya (solutions): Can you paste the exact API response and which AZ/region they're hitting?
Jordan (sales-eng): Hitting ap-southeast-1. API returns `\{"code\":404, \"message\":\"model unavailable in region\", \"model\":\"redwood-2.1\"\}`. When they switch to `redwood-2.1-quant` the calls sometimes get `429 Too Many Requests` under load.
Sam (eng-runtime): Quick triage: full-precision 2.1 wasn't staged to APAC last week — upstream image was retired. Quant variant is available but their load pattern triggers the burst rate limiter.
Jordan (sales-eng): Customer policy requires pinning an exact model id for QA. Any way to preserve the pinned id while serving the quant variant safely?
Sam (eng-runtime): We can create a per-account alias mapping: user-visible pin remains `redwood-2.1` but route their traffic to `redwood-2.1-quant-apac`. This preserves the pinned string in their config. We'll do a scoped routing rule so other tenants unaffected.
Maria (security): If you do that, security wants a short statement: alias-only routing, no weight/weight-file modifications, KMS key used for that model in APAC, and a commit to export access logs for 90 days to their audit bucket. Otherwise compliance won't sign off.
Priya (solutions): For the demo we can accept functional parity only — latency differences noted but fine. We should note this as a temporary mitigation in the SOW.
Sam (eng-runtime): Implementation plan: 1) create alias `redwood-2.1` scoped to acct:acct-7788 -> target `redwood-2.1-quant-apac`. 2) canary 5% then promote. 3) temporarily bump their token rate-limit window + burst allowance for 45 minutes. I'll file the deploy and tag infra.
Jordan (sales-eng): Will this require infra on-call?
Sam (eng-runtime): No full maintenance load, but infra needs to approve the alias because it skips the normal regional deployment checks. I'll ping infra-bot for approval.
infra-bot: approval request received: alias-create acct-7788 redwood-2.1 -> redwood-2.1-quant-apac. Escalation channel: #eng-infra.
Sam (eng-runtime): Also we should capture the KMS arn and the audit path before we flip. Maria, can you confirm retention policy?
Maria (security): Retention 90 days minimum. Provide KMS arn and a statement in the ticket that weights were not altered — alias only. Once that's attached I can rubber-stamp for the demo.
Sam (eng-runtime): KMS: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:999888777666:key/apac-quant-key-77. No weight changes, routing-only alias. Logs will be exported to s3://audit-redwood/poc/acct-7788/1953334444/ with lifecycle 90d.
infra-bot: deploy started: alias-create/1953334444 acct-7788 -> redwood-2.1-quant-apac (canary 5%)
Sam (eng-runtime): Canary metrics look fine. I'm applying a transient rate-window increase (+100 req/min) for 45m. Monitoring enabled.
infra-bot: deploy promoted to 100% for scoped alias alias-acct-7788-1953334444. audit-log: https://audit.redwood.internal/poc/1953334444
Maria (security): Verified KMS arn and audit export. Approve for demo only; require SOW addendum that this is a temporary alias and production should use Dedicated or Private with full-precision pin.
Priya (solutions): Adding SOW note now: "Temporary per-account alias routing redwood-2.1 -> redwood-2.1-quant-apac for POC demo; transient rate increase applied. Production plan to be scoped separately (Dedicated/private recommended)."
Jordan (sales-eng): Demo passed, customer accepted the temporary alias for the POC. Security signed off with audit link. Please revert rate bump when demo window closes. Thanks team. :party_popper:
